description: This file defines a Gradle plugin for configuring JVM library conventions in a Kotlin-based Android project. It applies necessary plugins, configures Kotlin and Spotless formatting, and manages dependencies.

classes.name: JvmLibraryConventionPlugin
classes.description: A custom Gradle plugin class implementing the Plugin interface for Project, establishing JVM library conventions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Initializes the plugin on a given Gradle Project, applying plugins, configuring Kotlin and Spotless, and setting up dependencies.
